replacementObligations: Scalar C/F/full64D arithmetic requires no allocation: preserve upperC, exact nibble-clear versus wholeword-copy guards, sticky08 unsigned predicate and ordered additions. It is not an exact ADD88 replacement by itself.

A no-allocation consume needs every reached metadata/command/stamp/dirty/ABI effect proved equivalent, a compatible fetch hit or proved no-patch path, exact G2928/G2924/G2920 and local-control flags, command capacity and later caller clearing. Earlier PS metadata/command effects precede C/F stores and cannot be moved across unknown aliases.

Refuse before writes on recorded/unsupported Z or alternate paths, bugcheck/import/metadata or pointer bounds, fetch miss/busy/inline without complete history and allocator model, command pressure/unmodeled C588/C270, unknown alias/frame/caller-live parity, state races or service/root lifetime. Current key equality alone does not establish retained C*(t) or future Original coherence.
guards: Known writer syntax is not an exhaustive all-alias store proof; direct-reader absence does not license dropping C, F or G319C.
Returned dirty masks are not ADD88 writes to G10. Z-tail clears, local mode and temporary color are separate from persistent control/color stores.
No additional dirty-mode consume is admitted; runtime state/frequency was not observed.
conclusion: The mode/control and color fold is exactly computable, but it triggers shared metadata/fetch and retained command/shadow effects. A scalar replay alone cannot remove dirty-mode Original work; the complete selected path and its reader/allocator/history frontiers remain the consume contract.
